reviews.review_text: First time buying the eye patches. I aint been using them long, & im sure i see a difference. But, i dont think id be able to keep up using them, cause of the price. Otherwise, i do like thrm and i recommend them if you can afford them.

I absolutely love this product! If you have tired or puffy eyes, it works wonders. It instantly refreshes your under eye area and makes your eyes look brighter and more awake. A must have in my skincare routine!

Unfortunately my entire order was not sent for 10 days as a very small sample was out of stock. As a result i had to go out and purchase the items i needed for a wedding i was attending and wait a further week for my refund. Very disappointed.

Me encanta todo el skincare de la marca, tenía muchísimas ganas de probar estos parches y ha sido una decepción enorme. Lo primero es que no se quedan en la zona del ojo, tengo que estar colocándolos constantemente porque se bajan a las mejillas, lo peor es el escozor y picor que me producen en la zona de la ojera, no aguanto con ellos puestos los 10 minutos que recomienda la marca. Es un producto con un precio elevado que no puedo usar
